splits.commit_message:
docs(auto-detect): update project documentation files

Updated CONTRIBUTING.md, METRICS.md, ROADMAP.md, and SYSTEM_DESIGN.md to improve clarity and accuracy.

chore(api): update env example and recap tests

- Updated apps/api/.env.example with latest environment variables.
- Modified recap tests in compose.test.ts, prose.test.ts, and week.test.ts to improve coverage and reliability.

refactor(auto-detect): improve auto-detect logic and tests

- Refactored auto-detect implementation in run.ts
- Updated integration tests for scanner and routes
- Enhanced test helpers for scanner

This improves code maintainability and test reliability.

feat(db): add leaderboard outbox migration

- Introduced new migration 0012_leaderboard_outbox.sql to support leaderboard outbox functionality.
- Updated migration journal to include the new migration.
- Modified schema.ts to reflect changes related to the leaderboard outbox.

This update enables tracking and processing of leaderboard events through the outbox pattern.

feat(web): add new features to profile editing and API

- Enhance EditProfile page with improved user interactions
- Update API utilities for better data handling
- Integrate push notification support
- Refactor App component to support new features

These changes improve user experience and backend communication.

docs(auto-detect): update architecture and system design docs

Updated ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md, README.md, and SYSTEM_DESIGN.md to improve clarity and accuracy of the auto-detect feature documentation.

feat(apps/web): update App component and styles

- Modified App.tsx to enhance functionality
- Updated index.css for improved styling

These changes improve the user interface and overall app experience.

chore(auto-detect): update changelog with recent changes

Updated the CHANGELOG.md file to reflect the latest modifications and improvements in the project.

fix(apps/api): correct team handling in API routes

Resolved issues in team-related logic within the API routes and library files to ensure proper data processing and response handling.

docs(apps/web): update documentation pages content

Updated the Changelog and Teams pages to improve clarity and accuracy of the documentation.

docs(auto-detect): update changelog and metrics documentation

- Updated CHANGELOG.md with recent changes
- Revised METRICS.md to reflect current metrics tracking

These updates improve documentation accuracy for the auto-detect feature.

feat(web): add new feature to App and update styles

- Updated App.tsx with new functionality
- Modified index.css for improved styling
- Enhanced changelog generation in lib/changelog.ts

chore(auto-detect): update config.yaml for auto-detect settings

Updated the config.yaml file to improve or modify the auto-detect configuration parameters.

refactor(auto-detect): improve auto-detect logic in config package

Refactored the auto-detect functionality within the config package to enhance clarity and maintainability. Changes span internal/config/config.go, config_test.go, and load.go to streamline configuration detection and loading processes.

feat(auto-detect): add entropy calculation with sliding window

- Implement entropy calculation logic in entropy.go
- Add sliding window support in window.go
- Include comprehensive tests for entropy and window modules

This feature enhances the auto-detect package by providing entropy-based analysis using a sliding window approach.

refactor(auto-detect): improve metrics auto-detect logic

Refactored the auto-detect functionality within the metrics package, updating noop.go, prometheus.go, prometheus_test.go, and recorder.go to enhance code clarity and maintainability without changing external behavior.

chore(auto-detect): update README with auto-detect info

Updated the README.md file to include details about the new auto-detect feature.

refactor(layout): improve component structure and layout

Refactored web/src/app/layout.tsx, web/src/app/page.tsx, and web/src/components/Architecture.tsx to enhance code organization and maintainability without changing functionality.

feat(auto-detect): add auto-detect feature to sweep benchmarks

Implemented auto-detection capabilities across sweep benchmark modules including cost, replay, report, and stats. Updated corresponding tests to cover new functionality and ensure reliability.
